title: Amazon Web Services IAM user access key: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]
summary: Synthetic Amazon Web Services IAM user access key values built to the documented format appear in 2 inputs in CI configuration and source code. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Standalone access-key ID without secret key/session token. Some legacy ASIA values also use digits outside the base32 alphabet.
